source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The comm localization port imports L10nDescriptionSchema and supplies that symbol to both ValidateSchema calls in the transform sequence. One checkpoint remains before dependency/keyed/chunk processing and the second remains after chunk_locales. Both ordinary and shippable localization kinds select this module. The next import-order correction is a separate landing, as are later signing and signoff changes. This proves the comm call sites and selected module, not the unpaired Gecko schema export, validator implementation or a successful generated task graph.
title: The localization schema port updates both validation checkpoints
